name: platform-trust-chain-series
description: The Platform Trust Chain Series: four open systems-security monographs (Windows, Apple, Linux, Android) by Parag Mali.
author: Parag Mali <https://paragmali.com>

scripts.diagrams: python3 books/windows/tools/gen_diagrams.py && python3 books/apple/tools/gen_diagrams.py && python3 books/linux/tools/gen_diagrams.py && python3 books/android/tools/gen_diagrams.py
scripts.build: mdbook build && SITE_URL=https://maliparag.github.io/trust-chain node tools/gen-seo.mjs && python3 tools/batch_readalong.py
scripts.pdfs: node tools/build-pdf.mjs --book windows && node tools/build-pdf.mjs --book apple && node tools/build-pdf.mjs --book linux && node tools/build-pdf.mjs --book android
